title: .factory/config.yaml
description: A target repo's overlay on the central policy (spec §7, §8.1). It may add or tighten protected paths, add egress_extra hosts and lower budgets; any other key is rejected. Loosening is caught by applyOverlay, which needs the base policy to compare against.

protected_paths.description: Repo-relative glob -> the modes to tighten. For a glob in the base policy, unnamed modes keep the base value. A new glob may name only ask or deny (applyOverlay rejects allow), and its unnamed modes add no rule. A file's mode is the strictest across every glob that matches it, so a new glob never loosens another. null means removal, which applyOverlay always rejects.

egress_extra.description: Hosts added to the archon zone's allowlist. Never a forge host.

budgets.description: Budgets to lower. Each value must be at most the base value.
